which is the most appropriate one word substitution of the following?

A post with little work but high salary:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Sinecure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sinecure"** refers to a position requiring little or no work but giving the holder status or financial benefit. (निःकर्म पद)

 
 
• **Example:** He was offered a sinecure in the company, which allowed him to enjoy a high salary without much work.
 
 
 
• **"Sinecure"** is derived from the Latin phrase "sine cura," meaning "without care." It typically refers to a position that brings financial gain without demanding much responsibility or effort from the holder. (निःकर्म पद)
 
 
• **Example:** The job was essentially a sinecure, requiring him to show up only a few times a month.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sinecure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Director** (निर्देशक): A person who is in charge of an organization or a part of an organization.

 
 
• **Example:** The director of the company made several strategic decisions that helped in its growth.
 
 
 
• **Trustee** (ट्रस्टी): A person or organization that has been given responsibility for managing someone else's property or money through a trust.
 
 
• **Example:** As a trustee, he was responsible for managing the charity's funds.
 
 
 
• **Ombudsman** (लोकपाल): An official appointed to investigate individuals' complaints against maladministration, especially that of public authorities.
 
 
• **Example:** The ombudsman received numerous complaints about the new policy.
